source: references/source/*.jpg 의 손그림 캐릭터. 원자료를 자르거나 그대로 쓰지 않고 같은 무드로 다시 생성한다(D-035).
usage_note: 9개를 한 번에, 같은 seed·같은 공통 프롬프트로 생성한다. 한 개만 다시 만들면 선 굵기와 채도가 어긋나 나란히 놓았을 때 티가 난다.
common_style_prompt: Hand-drawn children's-book illustration in soft watercolor and colored pencil on lightly textured paper. Simple rounded shapes with visible, slightly wobbly pencil outlines of even weight. Gentle pastel washes with soft bleeding edges and faint paper grain. Minimal detail. Flat and friendly, calm and warm, never slick. A single character centered, full body, facing the viewer at a slight three-quarter angle, occupying about 80% of the frame with even margins on all sides. Fully transparent background. Square 1:1 composition at 1024x1024.
negative_prompt: no text, no words, no letters, no Korean characters, no watermark, no signature, no frame, no border, no background scenery, no ground, no drop shadow, no photorealism, no 3D render, no glossy highlights, no vector-sharp edges, no heavy outlines, no weapons, no blood, no explosion, no mushroom cloud, no fire, no menacing or frightening expression, no tears streaming, no human figures, no logos

characters.label: 즐거움
characters.subject_prompt: A small cream-colored cartoon sheep with a soft fluffy body, standing calmly on all four legs, ears held low and loosely relaxed (neither pricked up nor flattened back), a fluffy tail swaying gently. Eyes in soft relaxed curves, a small content smile. Calm and quiet, not excited or sleepy. Pencil line accents in yellow-green.

characters.label: 희망
characters.subject_prompt: A small green cartoon turtle with its head and neck stretched far out of its shell, craning upward and forward, front feet slightly lifted off the ground as if leaning eagerly forward. Eyes wide, round, and hopeful, looking toward something out of frame. Patient but eager, not anxious. Pencil line accents in soft lilac.

characters.label: 슬픔
characters.subject_prompt: A small round cartoon guinea pig sitting alone, body slightly hunched, ears folded close to its head, head tilted upward slightly as if calling out quietly. Quiet, not distressed. One small round water droplet near its cheek. Pencil line accents in sky blue.

characters.label: 분노
characters.subject_prompt: A small dark grey cat standing side-on with its back arched and fur bristling, ears flattened back, brows furrowed, mouth a small flat line, tail up and puffed. A soft orange watercolor glow blooms behind its shoulders. Grumpy and comical, never threatening. Pencil line accents in orange-red.

characters.label: 기쁨
characters.subject_prompt: A small grey cartoon rat leaping playfully with all four paws off the ground, body arched mid-air, mouth open in a delighted chirp, whiskers splayed outward. A few small motion lines trail beneath its paws. Pencil line accents in golden yellow.

characters.label: 사랑
characters.subject_prompt: A small warm-brown cartoon dog sitting upright, head tilted slightly, looking up with soft gentle eyes in a steady warm gaze, ears relaxed and forward. Three small pink hearts of different sizes float up from its chest. Pencil line accents in pink.

characters.label: 미움
characters.subject_prompt: A small black cartoon crow perched upright, feathers slightly ruffled at the neck, head tilted and turned to one side with a fixed, narrow-eyed stare in one direction. Watchful and unmoving, not aggressive. Pencil line accents in deep indigo.

characters.label: 공포
characters.subject_prompt: A small cream-colored cartoon rabbit crouching low with its body tucked in, both long ears folded flat back against its head, front paws held together close to its chest, perfectly still. Eyes wide and round, looking straight ahead. Quiet and frozen, not panicked. Pencil line accents in deep teal.

characters.label: 혐오
characters.subject_prompt: A small young cartoon chimpanzee with dark brown-black fur and a lighter tan face, body leaning back and twisting to one side, mouth open in a gape with lips pulled back, one hand raised in front of its chest as if pushing something away. Eyes scrunched into tight lines. Mildly repulsed and a little dramatic, never gross or grotesque. Pencil line accents in deep olive.
